advisory: Synopsis: A transition from La Niña to ENSO-neutral is expected in the next month, with ENSO-neutral favored through May-July 2026 (55% chance). In June-August 2026, El Niño is likely to emerge (62% chance) and persist through at least the end of 2026.
forecast_summary: La Niña conditions are currently present with the latest weekly Niño-3.4 index at -0.5°C. This indicates weak La Niña conditions in the equatorial Pacific. Models suggest a possibility of El Niño conditions developing later in the year. The probability chart below shows the seasonal forecast for La Niña (blue), Neutral (grey), and El Niño (red) conditions through the end of the year.
